en.quote: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, and maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven?
en.riddle: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth
en.speaker: Elihu

he.quote: מַלְּפֵנוּ מִבַּהֲמוֹת אָרֶץ וּמֵעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם יְחַכְּמֵֽנוּ
